title: A trial with a ready compute host keeps tests that need the sandbox on this machine and reports them passing
description: GY-3536: tests/trial-runtime.test.ts and tests/hard-math-negative.test.ts import the trial runner or the sandboxed benchmarks; on a compute host's shard there is no sandbox permission and they fail. A merge trial with a ready host runs those two files here, where they pass, while plain files still go to the host.

steps.name: Run a trial with a ready compute host and the two sandbox test files
